notes: «وَ غَيْرِهِ» (and others) is an unnamed co-transmitter on the level of Abd Allah ibn Jabala; the Imam Abu Abd Allah written inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying «أعتق أبو جعفر» is the Imam's own words, not a link; «رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ» and «عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ» are blessings
